title: Running a business
summary: This page provides information and links to various services for running and managing a business in New South Wales.

internal_links.text: Apply to install a street awning or business sign
Manage employee pay, leave and superannuation
Lodge an annual summary of financial affairs: Tier 1 and 2 associations
Get help when your small business is in debt
Personalised support The Service NSW Business Bureau offers one-on-one support for your business, including help with licences and permits.
Service NSW Business Profile With a Business Profile, you can keep track of your licences, applications, or support programs and search for government tenders.
Service NSW Business Bureau app Manage your business transactions, save and track licences, and connect with us via your mobile device.

faqs.q: Where can I find information on business compliance and regulation?
faqs.a: You can find information on compliance and regulation for businesses here: https://www.service.nsw.gov.au/services/compliance-and-regulation-businesses

faqs.q: How can I manage my employees and contractors?
faqs.a: Information on managing employees and contractors is available at https://www.service.nsw.gov.au/referral/managing-employees-and-contractors

faqs.q: What support is available for my business?
faqs.a: The Service NSW Business Bureau offers one-on-one support, including help with licences and permits. You can also use the Service NSW Business Profile to track licences and applications.

faqs.q: How can I get help if my small business is in debt?
faqs.a: You can get help when your small business is in debt by visiting this guide: https://www.service.nsw.gov.au/guide/get-help-when-your-small-business-is-in-debt
